newsitem.title: GERMANY: DuMont wants out from German SAT 1 channel - article.
newsitem.headline: DuMont wants out from German SAT 1 channel - article.

text.p: Cologne-based publisher Alfred DuMont is considering selling his 10 percent stake in the German television channel SAT 1, in which media baron Leo Kirsch is the main shareholder, according to a magazine report.

In an advance copy of an article to appear in Monday's Focus news magazine, DuMont said he was considering selling the stake to the Aktuell Presse Fernsehen (APF), another SAT 1 shareholder with 20 percent.
DuMont is quoted as saying that when he took the stake in SAT 1 he had imagined it would be a "serious broadcaster," but that he only watched the channel "predominantly for football."

He said Kirch was making large profits by supplying the channel with films and sporting events to which he owned the rights, while the other shareholders had too little power to influence the channel's schedule.
